entites.resume: Wilson's Wildlife Solutions is a paranormal publicly funded wildlife service based in Clackamas County, Oregon, specifically in the town of Boring. Although the Foundation has known of Wilson's Wildlife Solutions' existence and anomalous affiliations since 1999, it took nine years until the Ursus Maritimus Incident in 2008, for their existence to be officially recognized and a relationship established between the two…

noms.ja: 機動部隊アルファ-1 ("レッド・ライト・ハンド")訳注: 特に機動部隊オメガ-1 ("法の左手")が登場する場合"赤い右手"と表記されることが多い。
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Alpha-1（“Red Right Hand”-红右手）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Alpha-1 is a task force that reports directly to the O5 Council and is used in situations that require the strictest operational security. The task force consists of the Foundation's best and most loyal operatives, and serves as the O5 Council's special operations unit. Further information regarding MTF Alpha-1 is classified Level 5.

noms.ja: 機動部隊アルファ-4 ("ポニー・エクスプレス")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Alpha-4（“Pony Express”-小马快递）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Alpha-4 consists primarily of personnel trained to act as undercover employees and specialize in tracking, intercepting, and securing anomalous objects sent through postal and package delivery services worldwide.
Mobile Task Force Alpha-45 specializes in conducting cleanup and repair following destructive missions by other Task Forces.
Mobile Task Force Alpha-5 is a task force tasked with leading exploration missions.

noms.ja: 機動部隊アルファ-9 ("残された希望")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Alpha-9（“Last Hope”-最后的希望）

entites.resume: Training and utilizing humanoid SCP objects in the field, Mobile Task Force Alpha-9 "Last Hope" resurrects the original premise of Mobile Task Force Omega-7.

Mobile Task Force Beta-1 is a highly classified unit specializing in dealing with suspected cases of enemy infiltration within Foundation personnel and possible information leaks to other Groups of Interest.
Mobile Task Force Beta-10 is a task force trained to handle brief excursions into alternate timelines and/or realities.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ベータ-2 ("バイユー少年")訳注: バイユーとはルイジアナ州の川・湖・沼・池・湿地のこと。
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Beta-2 （“Bayou Boys”-河口男孩）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Beta-2 is a region specific task force based in Louisiana, trained to act in swamp and wetland environments.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ベータ-4 ("キャスタウェイズ")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Beta-4 is a task force created for the sole purpose of assisting and monitoring GoI-466 (Wilson's Wildlife Solutions) in their interactions with local fauna-based anomalies.
Mobile Task Force Beta-43 specializes in memetic interdiction. Based at Site-43.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ベータ-7 ("マズ帽子店")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Beta-7（“Maz Hatters”-疯帽商）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Beta-7 specializes in the acquisition and containment of anomalies exhibiting extreme biological, chemical, or radiological hazards as well as the rapid containment and cleanup of areas affected by such anomalies. This includes the planning and deployment of contingencies for wide-area or pandemic spread of anomalous disease agents or other contagious phenomena.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ベータ-777 ("ヘカテーの槍")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Beta-777 (“Hecate's Spear”-赫卡忒之矛）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Beta-777 specializes in thaumaturgical ritual analysis and countermeasures; including thaumaturgical combat. Based at Site-91.

noms.ja: 機動部隊カイ-7 ("疫病テイマー")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Chi-7（“Plague Tamers”-瘟疫驯化师）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Chi-7 specialize in the containment of microbiological, biochemical, and pathogenic anomalies. Based at Site-234.

noms.ja: 機動部隊カイ-9 ("読む手がやめられないとまらない本")訳注: 原語では"Page Turners"。あまりの面白さに最後まで読み通してしまう魅力ある本のこと。"ページ・ターナー"と表記した場合多分原語の持つ意味が通じないと思われるが、そうしても良い。
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Chi-9（“Page Turners”-翻书器）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Chi-9 specializes in the detection, recovery, and neutralisation of anomalous literature.

noms.es: DM Delta-14 ("El País de las Maravillas Invernal")
noms.ja: 機動部隊デルタ-14 ("冬景色")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Delta-14（“Winter Wonderland”-冬季仙境）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Task Delta-14 specializes in handling and containing anomalies in subzero or cold environments, or anomalies related to snow.
Mobile Task Force Delta-20 specializes in anomalous recreational drugs and narcotics.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Delta-3（“Solomon's Hand”-所罗门之手）

entites.resume: Formed in late 1985 as a test case for the Special Asset Task Force Program (an initiative to employ persons with paranormal abilities as field agents), Mobile Task Force Delta-3 was stationed at Site-246 underneath Lake Superior for the duration of its existence. Dissolved in 1990 after the loss of its primary Special Asset Agent.

Mobile Task Force Delta-4 is a rapid response task force, specializing in being the first deployed to a scene. They're tasked with establishing a perimeter and assessing the situation, as well as providing additional manpower to other task forces when they arrive.
Aerial Mobile Task Force Delta-45 is deployed as air support during Foundation operations.

noms.ja: 機動部隊デルタ-5 ("トップランナー")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Delta-5（“Front Runners”-前线奔跑者）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Delta-5 is composed of multiple autonomous deep-cover cells specializing in the identification and pre-emptive acquisition of anomalous objects and entities of interest to other Groups of Interest.

noms.ja: 機動部隊イプシロン-11 ("九尾狐")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Epsilon-11（“Nine-Tailed Fox”-九尾狐）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Epsilon-11 handles internal security for the SCP Foundation, under oversight by MTF Alpha-1. They are a special ops force deployed to Foundation Sites when standard protocols fail and multiple breaches are imminent. As such, most of their operations are classified.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Epsilon-13（“Manifest Destiny”-昭昭天命）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Epsilon-13 is a task force trained in the exploration of expansive unknown terrain. Based at Site-81.
Mobile Task Force Epsilon-33 specializes in the recovery and containment of anomalies already distributed to the public, with a particular focus on anomalous motor vehicles.

noms.ja: 機動部隊イプシロン-6 ("村のアホ")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Epsilon-6（“Village Idiots”-乡里愚人）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Epsilon-6 specializes in the investigation, containment, and subsequent cleanup of anomalies in rural and suburban environments.

noms.ja: 機動部隊イプシロン-7 ("勿忘草")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Epsilon-7（“Forget Me Nots”-勿忘我）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Epsilon-7 specializes in the undercover disruption of the research and development of mnestic drugs. MNESTIC IS THE CORRECT TERM HERE. PLEASE DO NOT CHANGE IT. --

noms.ja: 機動部隊イプシロン-9 ("火喰らい")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Epsilon-9（“Fire Eaters”-噬火者）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Epsilon-9 specializes in the use of incendiary weaponry and operations in high-temperature environments.

noms.fr: FIM Êta-10 ("Ne voient pas le Mal")
noms.ja: 機動部隊エータ-10 ("シー・ノー・イーヴル")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Eta-10（“See No Evil”-非礼勿视）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Eta-10 specializes in the investigation, acquisition, and initial containment of objects or entities exhibiting visual cognitohazards, visual memetic agents, or otherwise requiring indirect or alternative observation in order to safely handle.

noms.ja: 機動部隊エータ-11 ("獰猛な獣たち")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Eta-11（“Savage Beasts”-残忍野兽）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Eta-11 specializes in the investigation, acquisition, and containment of auditory and musical anomalies, including any auditory cognitohazards or sound-based anomalous threats.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Eta-13 （“Gulliver's Tourists”-格列佛旅者）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Eta-13 was created to journey into a massive series of tunnels extending through extra-dimensional space, colloquially known as "The Gate".

noms.ja: 機動部隊エータ-4 ("失せろトリ頭")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Eta-4 （“Begone Thoth”-透特滚蛋）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Eta-4 is a unit of intelligent SCP-3095-affected seabirds. Eta-4 specializes in information collection and analysis, complementary field research and support, and in extreme cases, airborne combat. The task force was ultimately charged with protecting humanity after the BE-Class "Migration" End-of-Consciousness Scenario.

noms.ja: 機動部隊エータ-5 ("イェーガーボマー")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Eta-5 （“Jäeger Bombers”-猎人轰炸机）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Eta-5 is a rapid-response unit specializing in the tracking, capturing, and containment of Large-Scale Aggressors (entities over 30m in height). Deploys from, and detains LSAs within Dimensional-Site-172.

noms.fr: FIM Êta-77 ("Des Sphères dans des Sphères")
noms.ja: 機動部隊イータ-77 ("球中球")訳注: "球体を持った球体"と訳されることもある。
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Eta-77（“Spheres Within Spheres”-球中之球）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Eta-77 is the Department of Tactical Theology's special operations unit, consisting of fifteen members experienced in dealing with aggressive or threatening religion-related anomalies.

noms.zh-CN: MTF Gamma-1 ("Search and Destroy"-见敌必杀)

entites.resume: MTF Gamma-1 is a task force consisting of Foundation agents trained and specialized in neutralizing anomalous entities and objects that threaten the secrecy of the O5 Council.

noms.es: DM Gamma-13 ("Portadores de las Leyes de Asimov")
noms.ja: 機動部隊ガンマ-13 ("アシモフ三原則の番人")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Gamma-13（“Asimov's Lawbringers”-阿西莫夫执法队）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Gamma-13 specializes in the investigation, tracking, and apprehension of anomalous objects, persons, and entities associated with GoI-1115 (Anderson Robotics). This includes identification of Anderson customers, location of Anderson products and conduction of raids on Anderson offices.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ガンマ-4 ("金髭船長の手下たち")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Gamma-4（“Green Stags”-绿牡鹿）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Gamma-4 is a five-man task force specialized in performing tasks in low to zero-gravity and vacuum environments. Based at Lunar Area-32.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Gamma-44（“Meat Lockers”-锁肉柜）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Gamma-44 is tasked with investigating and dismantling all possible GoI-0432 ("The Hunter's Black Lodge") cells located within the Western United States.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ガンマ-5 ("燻製ニシンの虚偽")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Gamma-5（“Red Herrings”-红鲱鱼）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Gamma-5 specializes in preventing the dissemination of knowledge of anomalous events or phenomena in cases where initial suppression efforts have proven ineffective or insufficient, or in cases where such knowledge has already reached critical levels of public exposure. This includes the research and deployment of experimental amnestics as well as memory fabrication procedures.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ガンマ-6 ("大食らい")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Gamma-6（“Deep Feeders”-深渊喂食者）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Gamma-6 specializes in the investigation and tracking of deep-sea or oceanic anomalies. Research Site-45 serves as a staging point for Gamma-6 operations within the Pacific and Indian Oceans.

noms.en: MTF Gamma-89 ("Rock and a Hard Place")
noms.fr: FIM Gamma-89 ("Rock and a Hard Place")
noms.es: DM Gamma-89 ("Entre la Espada y la Pared")
noms.pl: MFO Gamma-89 ("Rock and a Hard Place")
noms.zh-CN: MTF Gamma-89 ("Rock and a Hard Place"-悬崖峭壁)

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Gamma-89 specializes in the containment of geological anomalies. Based at Site-898.

noms.ja: 機動部隊イオタ-10 ("ポリ公")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Iota-10（“Damn Feds”-该死的联邦探员）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Iota-10 maintains undercover operatives in various international, federal, and provincial law enforcement agencies and specializes in facilitating the transfer of anomalous evidence and objects into Foundation control as well as the transfer of jurisdiction over anomalous event locations from local law enforcement to Foundation containment and response teams.
Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna Ipsylon-11 wykorzystuje SCP-4793 w walce przeciwko członkom Rebelii Chaosu, specjalizując się w obronie przed wrogami.
Pomoc w zabezpieczaniu obiektów: * SCP-2417 * SCP-4137 * SCP-4581 * SCP-4631 * SCP-7154 * SCP-8514
Pomoc w zabezpieczaniu obiektów: * SCP-1018 * SCP-1226 * SCP-3435 * SCP-6589 * SCP-7586 * SCP-7669 * SCP-7829 * SCP-8278 * SCP-8853 * SCP-8877 * SCP-9292
Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna Ipsylon-33 specjalizuje się w zabezpieczaniu anomalii związanych z GOI-478 ("Pseudogenesis Productions").
Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Pierwotnie stworzona do przechowywania SCP-2559, Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna Ipsylon-4 ma za zadanie przechowywanie epidemiologiczne, a zwłaszcza wyłomów memetycznych.

Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna Jota-10 utrzymuje tajnych agentów w różnych międzynarodowych, federalnych i prowincjonalnych organach porządku publicznego oraz specjalizuje się w ułatwianiu przenoszenia anomalnych dowodów i obiektów pod kontrolę Fundacji jak również przekazywaniu zespołom przechowawczym i reagowania Fundacji postępów śledztw wobec miejsc anomalnych zdarzeń.

noms.ja: 機動部隊カッパ-10 ("スカイネット")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Kappa-10 is a temporary designation until such time it is either officially dissolved or sanctioned. It is strictly tasked in investigating and engaging 'cyber-anomalies' using a combination of virtual agents (AICs) and Foundation researchers to track, neutralize, and/or contain such intangible threats.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Kappka-14（“AH! Sideshow Bob!”-嘿！杂耍鲍勃）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Kappa-14 is tasked with investigation into GoI-233 ("Herman Fuller's Circus of the Disquieting"), and the containment of anomalies related to the group.

noms.ja: 機動部隊カッパ-43 ("仲介人")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Kappa-43 （“The Mediators”-媒介人）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Kappa-43 specialize in the investigation, tracking, and apprehension of anomalous objects and media associated with GoI-5889 (Vikander-Kneed Technical Media) and amnestization of any witnesses. Based at Site-43.
Pomoc w zabezpieczaniu obiektów: * SCP-001: The Problem * SCP-1983 * SCP-7548 * SCP-8273 * SCP-8530 * SCP-9009 * SCP-9042 * SCP-9537 * SCP-9992
Pomoc w zabezpieczaniu obiektów: * SCP-069 * SCP-5058 * SCP-5799
Pomoc w zabezpieczaniu obiektów: * SCP-4382 * SCP-5858 * SCP-6218 * SCP-8125

Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Formacja Operacyjna Ksi-8 jest formacją operacyjną o wielkości batalionu, przeznaczoną do nabywania i/lub poddawania terminacji sarkickich bytów i artefaktów. Utworzona w odpowiedzi na narastające zagrożenie ze strony Sarkistów, Ksi-8 obejmuje swoim działaniem wszystkie sześć głównych kontynentów, jeżeli będzie wymagane, wraz ze wsparciem morskim zapewnionym przez Fundację.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ラムダ-12 ("媒介害獣除染隊")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Lambda-12 (“Kinkshamers”-性怪癖藐视者)

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Lambda-12 specializes in tracking, containing, and exterminating anomalous vermin. Often used as a first-response team when tracking anomalous organisms.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ラムダ-14 ("一ツ星レビュアーズ")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Lambda-14（“One Star Reviewers”-一星评审员）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Lambda-14 specializes in dealing with retail-oriented locations and anomalies, be they singular restaurants or entire shopping districts displaying anomalies. Since their initial investigation of The Ambrose Restaurant, MTF Lambda-14 has been assigned to combat this group.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ラムダ-4 ("野鳥観察")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Lambda-4 specializes in the identification, tracking, and containment of airborne biological anomalies, especially anomalous avian organisms.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ラムダ-5 ("シロウサギ")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Lambda-5 specializes in traversing unstable, surreal, and controlled reality, and containing potentially dangerous persons and artifacts capable of manipulating space and time.

noms.zh-CN: MTF Lambda-9 ("Mind over Matter"-心胜于物)

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Lambda-9 specializes in investigating, containing, and in some cases, terminating psionic phenomena. Some members possess psionic capabilities.

noms.zh-CN: MTF Mu-0 (“Maxwell's Demons”-麦克斯韦恶魔)

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Mu-0 specializes in containing demons or demonology-related anomalies.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ミュー-13 ("ゴーストバスターズ")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Mu-13（“Ghostbusters”-捉鬼敢死队）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Mu-13 specializes in the tracking, analysis, and containment of incorporeal or intangible manifestations and entities, particularly those believed to be sentient, sapient, or otherwise intelligent and adaptive.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ミュー-3 ("最高額入札者")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Mu-3（“Highest Bidders”-最高出价的投标人）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Mu-3 is based at Site-90, and is dedicated to monitoring GoI 'Marshall, Carter & Dark Ltd'. Through the combined efforts of undercover agents and covert-ops specialists, their objective is: identifying objects of interest in possession of Marshall, Carter and Dark; isolating opportunities to recover these objects; and, ultimately achieving their containment.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ミュー-4 ("デバッガー")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Mu-4 specializes in the identification, tracking, retrieval, and containment of electronic devices and transmissions, especially anomalous computers and network-related anomalies. This includes the investigation of internet sites suspected of anomalous capabilities or involved in anomalous events.
Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna My-0 specjalizuje się w powstrzymywaniu demonów lub anomalii związanych z demonologią.

Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna My-13 specjalizuje się w śledzeniu, analizie, oraz przechowywaniu bezcielesnych lub niematerialnych manifestacji i bytów uważanych za świadome, rozumne, bądź inaczej inteligentne i adaptacyjne.

Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna My-3 jest dedykowana monitorowaniu Organizacji "Marshall, Carter and Dark Ltd". Poprzez łączone wysiłki przykrywkowych agentów i specjalistów ds. tajnych operacji, ich celem jest: identyfikacja interesujących obiektów znajdujących się w posiadaniu Organizacji Marshall, Carter and Dark; izolowanie możliwości na odzyskanie tych obiektów; oraz ostateczne osiągnięci…

Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna My-4 specjalizuje się w identyfikacji, śledzeniu, odzyskiwaniu i przechowywaniu urządzeń elektronicznych oraz transmisji, a szczególnie anomalnych komputerów i anomalii związanych z Internetem. Wliczając w to badanie stron internetowych podejrzanych o anomalne właściwości lub zaangażowane w anomalne wydarzenia.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Nu-3 （“Limnophobia”-湖泊恐惧症）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Nu-3 contains anomalies within Lake Ontario. Based at Site-201.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ニュー-7 ("下される鉄槌")

entites.resume: Armed Mobile Task Force Nu-7 is a battalion-strength force consisting of three company-sized elements of special operations infantry forces, a light armored vehicle company, tank platoon, helicopter squadron, chemical-biological-radiological-nuclear (CBRN) platoon, combat engineer platoon, nuclear weapon specialist (NWS) squad, plus additional combat specialist and support personnel.…
Pomoc w zabezpieczaniu obiektów: * SCP-2742 * SCP-4131 * SCP-4631

Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Zbrojna Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna jest batalionem składającym się z trzech wyspecjalizowanych pułków piechoty wielkości kompanii, kompanii lekkich pojazdów opancerzonych, plutonu czołgów, szwadronu śmigłowców, plutonu chemiczno-biologiczno-radiologiczo-nuklearnym (CBRN), pułku inżynierii polowej, zespołu specjalistów ds.…

noms.ja: 機動部隊オメガ-0 ("アラ・オルン")訳注: アラ・オルン (Ará Orún) はヨルバ人(ナイジェリアにいる西アフリカ最大の民族(3000万人超))の伝統宗教における祖先の魂。

entites.resume: The "saints" of MTF Omega-0 are informational constructs with the memories of deceased Foundation personnel able to manifest through access of the Foundation's intranet terminals. Using Identity Warfare Training (IWT) they protect their living comrades against informational threats and entities. The existence of MTF ω-0 is unknown to most or all of the living members of the Foundation.

noms.es: DM Omega-1 ("La Mano Siniestra de la Ley")
noms.ja: 機動部隊オメガ-1 ("法の左手")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Omega-1（“Law's Left Hand”-律法左手）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Omega-1 are empowered to remove or execute high-ranking Foundation personnel if they are determined to be acting unethically. Answers only to the Ethics Committee, as their counterpart to the O5 Command's "Red Right Hand".

noms.ja: 機動部隊オメガ-12 ("アキレウスの踵")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Omega-12（“Achilles' Heels”-阿喀琉斯之踵）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Omega-12 is composed of reality bending Foundation personnel from an alternate universe, tasked with capturing other SCP-3480-2 instances, guarding the many anomalous entities imprisoned in Area-13, and hunting down powerful uncontained reality benders elsewhere.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Omega-20（“Thought Police”-思想警察）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Omega-20 consists of two groups of operatives: the WOLFs (Psychics) and the LANCEs (Non psychics). Specialized in detainment of Persons of Interest.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Omega-45（“Street Samurai”-街头武士）

entites.resume: Armed Mobile Task Force Omega-45 is an elite fighting force specialized in the use of anomalous weaponry, armor, and vehicles. Dispatched on missions to retrieve high-risk anomalies and in combat against hostile Groups of Interest. Based at Site-78.

noms.ja: 機動部隊オメガ-7 ("パンドラの箱")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Omega-7（“Pandora's Box”-潘多拉之盒）

entites.resume: --Mobile Task Force Omega-7 is an experimental task force specializing in the acquisition and containment of anomalies utilizing cooperative anomalous humanoid entities, particularly SCP-076 and SCP-105.-- Mobile Task Force Omega-7 has been disbanded and decommissioned; this entry is to be deleted by order of the Records and Information Security Administration.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Omega-9（“The Scrubs”-洗刷者）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Omega-9 consists of 3 anomalous entities available for near-instantaneous deployment into extreme circumstances requiring the delivery of overwhelming force. Its primary purpose is as a rapid-response team for containment breaches involving violent, hostile anomalies. As part of the agreement reached with these 3 entities, MTF Omega-9 is only to be used to eliminate hostile non-human targets.
Mobile Task Force Omicron-12 monitors various internet sites, to gather information and intercept anomalous activity.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Omicron-67 （“Zeroth Responders”-第零响应者）

entites.resume: 协助收容的项目： * SCP-5783
Wykorzystywane obiekty: * SCP-2842

noms.ja: 機動部隊ファイ-2 ("クレバー・ガールズ")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Phi-2（“Clever Girls”-聪明女孩）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Phi-2 specialize in the study, tracking, capture, and hunting of prehistoric anomalies, especially dinosaurs.

noms.ja: 機動部隊パイ-1 ("シティ・スリッカーズ")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Pi-1（“City Slickers”-城市滑头）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Pi-1 is based at Containment Site-28, and specializes in the investigation, containment, and subsequent cleanup of anomalies in densely-populated urban environments, particularly in the New York metropolitan area.

noms.fr: FIM Pi-43 ("Déchets en Entrée, Déchets en Sortie")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Pi-43（“Garbage In,Garbage Out”-垃圾进，垃圾出）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Pi-43 is responsible for the transfer of prisoners and anomalies in and out of Site-43.

Mobile Task Force Psi-10 is a worldwide network of psychologists, sociologists, and memeticists, most of whom are reserve Foundation employees assigned ad hoc, tasked with detecting, identifying and tracking anomalous memes and behaviors in the human population. Active in tracking SCP-2631 and SCP-3519 related effects.

noms.ja: 機動部隊プサイ-13 ("ウィッチ・ハンターズ")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Psi-13（“Witch Hunters”-女巫猎人）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Psi-13 is a highly classified joint Foundation/GOC task force designed for the infiltration of Sarkic organizations and the termination of high threat members. Operatives are trained in Counter Occult Stratagems (COS) and the use of corrosive and incendiary armaments.

noms.zh-CN: MTF Psi-18 ("Tenure Trackers”-终身教职追踪者)

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Psi-18 are an undercover task force in academia, focused on discovering and handling subtle anomalous phenomena. Compare with Mobile Task Force Delta-10 ("Answer Key"), which handles hostile or high-profile events and entities.

noms.ja: 機動部隊プサイ-7 ("リフォーム屋")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Psi-7（“Home Improvement”-家居装饰）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Psi-7 specializes in the undercover investigation, containment, and/or demolition of anomalous buildings or buildings affected by anomalies, particularly residential homes in populated areas. This includes the acquisition or transfer of affected buildings to Foundation control as well as initial observation and documentation of such buildings prior to transfer to local containment teams for long-ter…

noms.ja: 機動部隊プサイ-8 ("サイレンサー")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Psi-8 （“The Silencers”-消音器）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Psi-8 specializes in the investigation, tracking, containment and/or destruction of individuals suspected to be capable of or having been affected by reanimation anomalies, as well as investigating suspected cases of communication with deceased individuals.…

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Psi-9（“Abyss Gazers”-深渊凝视者）

entites.resume: Armed Mobile Task Force Psi-9 is a battalion-strength force, consisting of personnel from the Foundation and Global Occult Coalition, trained in unconventional warfare against invading enemies through the use of heavy artillery, DMT enhanced perception, and Counter Occult Stratagems (COS).

noms.zh-CN: MTF Rēsh-1 (“Seat of Consciousness”-意识之座)

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Rēsh-1 reports directly to the Administrator, serving as a counterpart to MTF Alpha-1 to keep the power of the O5 Council in check.
Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna Resz-1 podlega bezpośrednio Administratorowi i pełni funkcję odpowiednika formacji operacyjnych, mając na celu kontrolowanie władzy Rady O5.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ロー-1 ("プロフェッサー")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Rho-1 specializes in the acquisition, containment, and transport of anomalies related to Group of Interest Alpha-388, "Alexylva University". With the reduction of the threat posed by the specific GoI, the MTF has expanded its focus to any and all containment for anomalous academic endeavors.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ロー-19 ("キュテレイアンズ")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Rho-19（“Cythereans”-塞西莉亚人）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Rho-19 has been sent to Venus, in the hopes to establish a Foundation presence where there may be considerable anomalous activity.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Rho-43（“Home Invaders”-入室抢劫犯）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Rho-43 is dispatched to interior locations to investigate and or manage events relating to Site-43 and its personnel.

noms.zh-CN: 特殊特遣队Rho-7（“Greeting Party”-迎客队）

entites.resume: Special Task Force Rho-7 is an STF tasked with the preliminary evaluation of an anomaly, allowing for quick, partial containment, and the informed delegation of an appropriate MTF unit.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ロー-9 ("テクニカルサポート")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Rho-9（“Technical Support”-技术支持）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Rho-9 handles computer security for the Foundation. When memetic kill agents can lurk throughout a data structure, this is no simple task.
Mobile Task Force Sampi-6 is a task force with familiarity with the occult community, and experience with thaumaturgical threats.

noms.ja: 機動部隊シグマ-10 ("ナマケモノノテ")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Sigma-10（“The Sloth's Arm”-斯洛斯之臂）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Sigma-10 is based at Site-87, and is dedicated to the containment of dangerous anomalies within Nexus-18, better known as Sloth's Pit, Wisconsin.

noms.ja: 機動部隊シグマ-3 ("書誌学者")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Sigma-3 is charged with covert infiltration of the anomalous community for the purpose of gathering intel, with a particular focus on the vast otherworldly location of The Wanderers' Library.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Sigma-5（“';DROP TABLE task forces”-';删表特遣队--）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Sigma-5 is responsible for establishing and maintaining covert access to various social media and file sharing sites, for the purposes of disinformation and controlling the spread of computer-based anomalies.
Distributed Task Force Sigma-6 protects and maintains SCP-120’s facility and location outposts, and is composed of multiple units. Division 9 is stationed at Lunar Area-32.

noms.ja: 機動部隊シグマ-66 ("悲惨な炭鉱労働者")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Sigma-66 is formed of captured members from other GoI. Despite the lack of loyalty the Foundation expects from the assembled team, they find the members' expertise of value.

noms.ja: 機動部隊シグマ-9 ("戦乙女")

entites.resume: Aerial Mobile Task Force Sigma-9 is a small unit providing air support for ground operations or combat against aerial anomalies.

noms.en: MTF Stigma-9 (“Evolved from Naturally Occurring Gears, Levers and Pulleys”)
noms.fr: FIM Stigma-9 ("Évolués à partir de Rouages, Leviers et Poulies Apparues Naturellement")
noms.es: DM Estigma-9 ("Evolucionados de Palancas, Poleas y Engranajes Producidos Naturalmente")
noms.ru: МОГ Стигма-9 ("Произошедшие от естественно возникших шестерней, рычагов и шкивов")
noms.ja: 機動部隊スティグマ-9 ("自然発生する歯車、梃子、滑車からの進化")
noms.it: SSM Stigma-9 ("Evoluti da Meccanismi, Leve e Carrucole Occorrenti in Natura ")
noms.pl: MFO Stigma-9 ("Evolved from Naturally Occurring Gears, Levers and Pulleys")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Stigma-9（“Evolved from Naturally Occurring Gears, Levers and Pulleys”-从自然出现的齿轮，把手和滑轮演变而来）
noms.ko: 기동특무부대 스티그마-9 ("자연발생하는 톱니, 지레, 도르래에서 진화함")

entites.resume: Historically, the Church of the Broken God had always prided itself on its //artificiality// - that its faith is proven with tangible artifacts and physical devices of miracles. So, when the time came to destabilize the Church, the Foundation put forth a team of forgers, known as Mobile Task Force Stigma-9.
Mobile Task Force Tau-22 is a task force specialized in forested terrain and rural nature based recovery, tracking, and other missions.

noms.ja: 機動部隊タウ-5 ("サムサラ")

entites.resume: Immortal cyborg clones created from the flesh of a dead god, Mobile Task Force Tau-5 ("Samsara") utilizes esoteric and experimental Foundation weaponry to investigate and contain thaumaturgic and psionic threats.

noms.ja: 機動部隊タウ-51 ("アーバン・ブロウル")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Tau-51（“Urban Brawl”-城市斗殴）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Tau-51 specializes in the containment and recovery of SCP objects from urban environments, especially in the anomalous city of Three Portlands.

noms.ja: 機動部隊タウ-9 ("紙魚")訳注: "本の虫"と訳されることもある。

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Tau-9 deals with anomalies related to the Library, the Serpent's Hand, and 'magic'; A more traditional counterpart to Sigma-3.

noms.ja: 機動部隊シータ-4 ("庭師")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Theta-4 specializes in the acquisition and containment of plant or plant-like anomalous objects and entities, especially fieldwork involving wide-spread infestations of such anomalies. Biological Containment Site-103 serves as the base of operations for Theta-4.

noms.ja: 機動部隊シータ-5 ("大船")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Theta-5（“The Bigger Boat”-更大的船）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Theta-5 specializes in anomalies involving or threatening marine vehicles.

noms.ja: 機動部隊シータ-90 ("角度研削者")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Theta-90 （“Angle Grinders”-角磨机）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Theta-90, the "Angle Grinders", specialize in operating in locations of anomalous topology/geometry and in securing anomalies connected with these kinds of spacetime distortions.

noms.fr: FIM Titan-1 ("En dehors des sentiers battus")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Titan-1（“Off the Books”-汝名已弑）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Titan-1 is deployed to safeguard VIPs and eliminate hostile groups of interest. They specialize in unconventional warfare, subterfuge, and fear tactics to throw enemies off-balance before raids.

Misja Formacji Operacyjnej: Mobilna Formacja Operacyjna Titan-1 została utworzona w celu ochrony VIP-ów i eliminacji wrogich organizacji. Specjalizuje się w niekonwencjonalnych działaniach wojennych, podstępach i taktykach zastraszania, które mają na celu wytrącenie przeciwników z równowagi przed atakiem.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Upsilon-11（“Avalon's Wake”-阿瓦隆的守灵夜）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Upsilon-11 utilizes SCP-4793 in combat against members of the Chaos Insurgency, specializing in defense against hostiles.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Upsilon-20（“Hogtown Garrison”-霍格敦驻军）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Upsilon-20 contains anomalies found in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and the surrounding areas. Based at Site-201.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Upsilon-23（“Art Critics”-艺术评论家）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Upsilon-23 specialize in the containment of anomalous art, primarily the anart originating from GoI-0267 (Are We Cool Yet?).
Mobile Task Force Upsilon-33 specializes in the containment of anomalies related to GOI-478 ("Pseudogenesis Productions").

noms.ja: 機動部隊ユプシロン-4 ("糖衣錠")

entites.resume: Originally formed in order to contain SCP-2559, Mobile Task Force Upsilon-4 is tasked with epidemiological containment, especially with the containment of memetic outbreaks.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Xi-13（“Sequere Nos”-汝随吾等）

entites.resume: Armed Mobile Task Force Xi-13 is a platoon-strength rapid response unit, tasked with responding quickly to dangerous and/or anomalous situations where the threat has not yet been identified but military-grade force is deemed likely, including but not limited to large scale containment and security breaches.

Mobile Task Force Xi-3 specializes in the covert rendition, interrogation, and potential containment of individuals suspected of anomalous influence or capability, including high-profile targets such as politicians and celebrities. Primarily based at Humanoid Containment Site-06.

noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Xi-5（“Newtons Bullies”-牛顿恶霸）

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Xi-5 is specially trained and equipped for expeditions into anomalous zones and alt-dimensional spaces deviating from baseline scientific principles.

noms.ja: 機動部隊クサイ-8 ("最後に倒れるもの")
noms.zh-CN: 机动特遣队Xi-8（“Last to Fall”-最后陨落）

entites.resume: Armed Mobile Task Force Xi-8 is a battalion-strength task force dedicated to the acquisition and/or termination of Sarkic entities and artifacts. Created as a response to the growing Sarkic threat, Xi-8's operational scope encompasses all six major continents, with naval support provided by the Foundation as needed.

noms.ja: 機動部隊ゼータ-9 ("メクラネズミ")

entites.resume: Mobile Task Force Zeta-9 specializes in the investigation, exploration, and containment of underground or enclosed areas exhibiting anomalous phenomena, particularly those with inconsistent topography or unstable spacetime.
Site-0 is a containment Facility that does not exist, for the purpose of containment and research into Unreality.

Site-01, also known as Overwatch HQ, is a safe zone that acts as a data backup for all major Foundation facilities worldwide, as well as a secure meeting facility for O5 Council members and other high-ranking Foundation personnel. All further details, including the location of Site-01, are strictly classified.

Specialising in the containment and study of plant anomalies, Site-101's conservatory holds the largest collection of anomalous flora in the Northern Hemisphere, and actively researches new pharmaceutical applications for these plants and their products.…

noms.zh-CN: 生物性收容站点-103Biological Containment Site-103

entites.resume: Site-103 possesses extensive facilities for the containment and research of plant and plant-based anomalies, and also serves as the base of operations for MTF-Theta-4, "The Gardeners". This sprawling complex of glasshouses and laboratories has been disguised as an institute for research into non-anomalous plants.…

noms.zh-CN: 生物性研究站点-104Biological Research Site-104

entites.resume: Formerly Provisional Site-104, this facility covers an area of more than 10 km, operating under the guise of a wildlife preserve for endangered species. The Site focuses on the containment and study of biological anomalies too large or too numerous to be contained in conventional facilities, although a number of greenhouses and indoor enclosures have been constructed within its perimeter to hold smaller anomalous org…

noms.zh-CN: 储藏与监察站点-106Storage and Surveillance Site-106

entites.resume: Site-106 consists of several facilities. The primary building serves as the logistical base and headquarters of the Department of Procurement & Liquidation, which specializes in acquiring and containing anomalous items through semi-legitimate financial means, including the purchasing of individual objects and corporate entities.…

Site-107, founded in early July of 2023, was established as a Foundation base in collaboration with the Arab Republic of Egypt after both entities reported a large uptick of anomalous activity within the region. The site's founding was finally approved despite several years of anomalous activity occurring within the region, with Director Heba Gomaa spearheading efforts to get a location founded on the African contine…

Site-11 is a large-scale Foundation facility consisting of an entire self-sustaining community, complete with residential housing, commercial businesses, and industrial/manufacturing facilities, as well as an extensive underground containment and research complex.…

Built from a hunted and quartered labyrinth, Site-118 specializes in the containment of ontokinetic, phobologic and nomenclative anomalies, focusing on Keter-Class objects and entities. Although not going as far as other Sites, containment at Site-118 relies on the facility's labyrinthine layout, as well as interactions between multiple anomalies to achieve mutual containment.

noms.es: Sitio-119 de Investigación y Contención de Ciberanomalías
noms.zh-CN: 网络异常收容与研究站点-119 Cyberanomalous Containment and Research Site-119

entites.resume: Site-119 is the Foundation's epicenter for cyberanomalous objects and other digital phenomena across the world. While intended to operate in tandem with Site-15 and other similar facilities for cyberanomalous containment and IT-related management, Site-119 has been uniquely equipped with significantly more advanced computational capabilities due to its importance in top secret projects and the Foundation's existing n…

noms.zh-CN: 研究与收容站点-12Research and Containment Site-12

entites.resume: Site-12 is situated underneath the Avon Dam, within the Dartmoor National Park. One of the first sites to be commissioned after the Foundation's formation, Site-12 focuses primarily on research and administration, and is one of the most important sites in the British Isles.…

noms.en: Research and Reliquary Dimensional Containment Site-120
noms.zh-CN: 研究与圣物维度性收容站点-120Research and Reliquary Dimensional Containment Site-120

entites.resume: Built atop SCP-5292, Site-120 specializes in thaumaturgic, ontokinetic, and theological anomalies, utilizing unconventional methods to contain them. One of the few Sites actively encouraging the usage of the anomalous, it acts as the main observation point for the Free Port of Esterberg.…

noms.zh-CN: 储藏与收容站点-13Storage and Containment Site-13

entites.resume: Site-13 is a facility used to contain anomalous objects and easy-to-contain sapient SCPs. It is primarily focused on the containment and the study of anomalies produced by Dr. Wondertainment. Hall 8 of Site-13, per O5-4's orders, is entirely dedicated to the containment of "Little Misters".

noms.zh-CN: 管理与档案站点-138Administration and Archive Site-138

entites.resume: Site-138 functions as the primary administrative hub for Foundation operations throughout Europe and North Africa. Its subterranean complexes maintain extensive repositories of records and documentation, alongside secure storage of Safe-class anomalous objects approved for unattended containment.

Site-14 is the primary hub for the SCP Foundation's Telecommunications Monitoring Office. It is their largest facility worldwide, with a staff of more than 1300 Foundation employees, screening calls from across the western hemisphere.…

Site-15 is a Foundation facility specialising in the containment and study of electric, electronic, and computer-based anomalies, within a building designed to blend in amongst the civilian tech companies of Silicon Valley. The storage and containment wings of Site-15 are electromagnetically isolated to prevent any interaction between anomalous electronics and the outside world.…

Site-169 is home to the Foundation’s only dedicated facilities for recreational activity. Overseen by the Anomalous Entity Engagement Division, anomalies are given temporary or extended stays at Site-169 as part of corrective procedures or positive reinforcement.…

Site-17 is the second largest Foundation facility, primarily focused on the containment and study of low-risk humanoid entities, although the Site has additional capacities for the containment of inanimate objects, non-humanoid creatures, and higher risk anomalies.…

Site-18 is a relatively small facility, primarily used for the storage and testing of anomalous objects. The Site also has a biological sector used for the containment of anomalous animals. Site-18 is not the Headquarters of the Department of Disinformation.

Disguised as a shipyard and naval research facility, Site-184 serves two purposes simultaneously. As the main Research & Containment Site on the east coast of Canada, the Site hosts cutting-edge facilities such as the Applied Metaphysics Research Laboratories, innovative Aquatic Anomalies facilities, and an Anomalous Art & Artefacts wing, in addition to supervising several satellite sites such as Mobile Site-184/A.…

Founded in 1981, Site-188 is located directly below Parliament House in Canberra. It was established after five weeks of negotiation with the Australian government following the discovery of a spatial anomaly during a survey of Parliament House's proposed location. The negotiations resulted in the New Parliament House Agreement and the simultaneous construction of both buildings.

Site-19 is the largest and one of the most important Foundation facilities currently in operation, housing hundreds of Safe- and Euclid-class anomalies, some located within additional Facilities separate from the main Site. Site-19 also has dedicated laboratories for the processing and storage of Anomalous Items not warranting their own Special Containment Procedures.…

A facility built to contain anomalous activity in and around Toronto and Lake Ontario. One of the main responsibilities of the site is maintaining the Arete Dimensional Array, a network of pipes and sensors on the lakebed designed to monitor fluctuations in spacetime and seal any dimensional tears that form.…

Site-22 is the Foundation's foremost physical therapy center, specializing in Modalities: anomalous massage techniques studied and contained by the Department of Massage Therapy. Site-22 is also home to the Foundation's largest equestrian center, which hosts horse-related anomalies and performs equine testing. Be welcome! We love you!

Site-222 is a secure research, containment, and development facility acting as the Foundation's hub for the field of horology, also known as the study of timekeeping. Site-222 serves as the headquarters for the Department of Applied Horology, with anomalous clocks from all across history being stored within the Site.

noms.zh-CN: 生物性研究与收容站点-225Biological Research & Containment Site-225

entites.resume: Site-225 is a large-scale containment facility predominantly focused on the containment and study of biological anomalies, primarily anomalous animals. One of the newest Foundation facilities in operation, Site-225 takes a more congenial approach to the containment of live anomalies and is home to the largest and most advanced veterinary facilities maintained by the Foundation.

Site-228 is a major Central European containment facility, one of the first Foundation facilities to be located in Hungary. It was originally designed for humanoid containment, but following modernization, it is now also capable of containing sapient non-humanoid entities.

Site-23 is used to store inanimate objects, particularly those with anomalous metamorphic or transfiguring effects on biological entities. The Site also possesses facilities for anomalous animal research, and for the cryogenic containment of deceased or inactive anomalous entities. The Site is publicly known to be a biological research facility, although the exact nature of its work is carefully concealed.…

Site-234 is the Foundation's center for the containment of Microbiological and Biochemical anomalies, disguised as pharmaceutical research laboratories. One of the Foundation's youngest facilities, constructed in the fall of 1983, and also one of the largest, containing more than 200 anomalies, housing 1000 personnel on site, and employing another 8000 that commute in from the surrounding area.…

Site-246 is located beneath Lake Superior and was the regional command site for the North American Great Lakes operations area until the establishment of Site-87. The Site was later reactivated to serve as the headquarters for MTF Delta-3 ("Solomon's Hand") as part of the Special Asset Task Force Program.…

noms.zh-CN: 镇压与档案站点-247Suppression and Archival Site-247

entites.resume: Location: Aspen Mountain, Wyoming, USA

Site-28 was initially established to contain SCP-602 within a former apartment building. Since then, it has been expanded into a containment facility with temporary and permanent housing for Foundation personnel, while maintaining the appearance of an ordinary apartment building with commercial space at street level.…
* Upper Troposphere ("The Hub, Site-300-01") * Northern Territory, Australia ("Site-300-12") * Krasnoyarsk Krai, Russia ("Site-300-14")

Site-322 specializes in the containment of sapient anomalies, as well as monitoring select offsite anomalies. Its unique contribution to the Foundation is its Integration Program, inspired by the discoveries of SCP-5031, which employs anomalies for their various abilities should they be found useful to the Foundation.
Site-33 maintains containment of several anomalies that require intensive maintenance due to contamination or damage to their containment measures.

Despite numerous proposals for its dissolution, Site-333 remains a general-purpose, low-cost containment facility for low-risk, low-threat anomalies and pseudo-anomalous phenomena within Nexus-36: Atlantic City.

Site-34 is the largest facility operated by the Spanish-speaking Branch of the Foundation. Serving as a regional hub for research and containment, the Site handles a wide variety of different anomalies, and also possesses administrative, manufacturing and medical facilities.…

Constructed around SCP-1135 and disguised as a military base, this facility specialises in theological anomalies. The Site also functions as a regional command facility for personnel operating in the area, coordinating Foundation operations across India and supervising facilities such as Adjunct Site-2498.…

Secure Facility 37 is a safe containment facility which acts as the headquarters for the Human Resources Department. Site-37 is underfunded and composed mostly of HR-cases, yet still leads the front in a current war against anomalous appliances. ||~ ID Number||~ Object Class|| || SCP-7119 || Safe || || SCP-7639 || Keter || || SCP-7939 || Euclid ||

Site-38 is an inanimate object containment site, primarily focused on the study of Group of Interest Alpha-388, the "Alexylva University". The Site's inland location has proven advantageous for the Foundation's Astronomy Department, and the Site has been disguised as a civilian observatory.…
Location: Site-19's Basement

noms.zh-CN: 收容与资源站点-400Containment and Resource Site-400

entites.resume: Established in 1918, Site-400 is a large-scale containment and resource production facility, located somewhere within the forested regions of Newcastle. Disguised as a private forestry research institute, Site-400 specializes in multiple fields of anomalous science, primarily paraastronomy, metafiction, and humanoid experimentation.…

Site-41 serves as the headquarters of the Antimemetics Division, which investigates objects and concepts that are anomalously difficult to remember or communicate. Site-41 is used for training, research, and the containment of SCP objects that require experts in antimemes.…

Site-418, the Foundation's first (and currently only) virtual containment facility, is built within the popular video game Minecraft. It is responsible for containing anomalies that are difficult to contain in the real world, such as informational para-organisms, as well as monitoring organizations and anomalies of concern that exist within Minecraft and the surrounding community.…

A facility used to contain sapient SCP objects. Following the public reveal of the Foundation, Site-42 could be significantly expanded, growing to the size of a small town now that secrecy was no longer necessary. However, this change came with increased scrutiny from the civilian population, requiring investment in public relations.

noms.zh-CN: 研究与收容站点-43Research and Containment Site-43

entites.resume: Site-43 is situated one kilometre below sea level on the southeastern shore of Lake Huron, a Nexus of anomalous activity. The Site takes an unconventional approach to the containment of its low- to medium-risk anomalies, and also possesses research divisions arranged in a pseudoacademic structure and abatement refineries for esoteric substances.

Initially founded for the investigation of the children's television company Sputnik Studios (GoI-411), Site-433 is a center for the research and containment of anomalous artwork. It has become the foremost facility for studying and containing Alucinari-Class Entities: poorly-understood beings believed to originate from the collective of human imagination, referred to in sub-Veil communities as "Toons."

noms.zh-CN: 研究与收容站点-44Research and Containment Site-44

entites.resume: Site-44 is a large facility situated beneath Foulness Island. Used primarily for research, containment, and task force training, but also handling administrative work, being the lead site for the Foundation’s operations within and around Britain. The area is publicly known as Ministry of Defence land, allowing Foundation activities to proceed without much concern for public discovery.…

OSWA Research Site-45 is an armed facility built beneath the Indian Ocean off the coast of Australia, with surface-level facilities disguised as an oil rig. The Site is used to conduct the research and containment of anomalous objects under armed guard and well away from a civilian populace. Site-45 also serves as a staging point for MTF operations within the Pacific and Indian Oceans.

--Site-5 is a man-made island constructed to store hazardous materials, currently used for the containment of SCP-001, SCP-001-EX, SCP-1661, SCP-2193, SCP-2923, SCP-3280, SCP-3963, SCP-3980, SCP-8110, SCP-8832 and SCP-9923--.

Located beneath the National Diet building complex, Site-50 (also referred to as Site-8150) was the former Headquarters of the Imperial Japanese Anomalous Matters Examination Agency, before being taken over by the Foundation in 1946 to serve as the center for the review of records previously collected by Japanese normalcy organisations.…
Southeast Asia is a place of rapid economic and anomalous growth, of magics and ghosts and oddities. It is also a region the Foundation has but a tenuous grip on.

noms.zh-CN: 集成收容站点-54Integrated Containment Site-54

entites.resume: Site-54 is a containment facility located in, around, and underneath the city of Leipzig. Specialising in the containment of those anomalies deemed "partially uncontainable", the Site's staff are heavily armed, highly trained, and permanently on edge.…

Site-55 is the centre of the Foundation's research into Groups of Interest, led by Dr. Jay Everwood. The Site's proximity to the extradimensional Wonder World!™ Location of Interest means that the Site is involved in the containment of a large number of Dr Wondertainment products, in addition to various objects with known or suspected ties to other organisations.…

Established in May 1972, Site-56 was intended to serve as the base of operations for the enactment of the Kraken Protocol within the American Southwest. Over time, Site-56 took on increasing responsibilities, eventually transitioning into one of the largest containment and administration sites in the US, responsible for select offsite anomalies such as SCP-5994 and SCP-5952.…

noms.es: Sitio-58 de Contención y Relaciones Anómalas
noms.zh-CN: 收容与异常联系站点-58Containment and Anomalous Relations Site-58

entites.resume: Site-58 is the Foundation's premier site for sapient humanoid and zoological anomalies. Its approach to containment is viewed as nontraditional, aiming for humane containment via direct communication and negotiation with contained anomalies. As a result anomalies are granted a level of freedom on site, allowed privileges within reason.
Site-59 contains a vast majority of the anomalies related to both the Three Moons Initiative and the TotleighSoft Corporation. Currently, the Site Director is Dr. Lisle Naismith.

noms.zh-CN: 人形生物收容站点-06-3Humanoid Containment Site-06-3

entites.resume: Site-06-3 is a containment facility housing numerous low-risk human and humanoid entities, most notably several former Foundation personnel. Site-06-3 employs a multi-national staff, and was formerly located in the United States of America (Site-06) and Germany (Site-06-2) prior to the decommission and demolition of these prior facilities.…

Formerly Provisional Site-62, this facility was built around and within SCP-004. The facility was eventually expanded to house other objects requiring high-security Dimensional Containment, back up critical Foundation data, and provide an external reference point for detecting and reporting reality shifts.…

Located approximately 0.5 km underground, Site-64 is a low to medium-security storage facility. It primarily houses anomalous art and paratechnology confiscated from various groups operating in Oregon, with a particular focus on the Three Portlands Free Port and the Boring Nexus. This has resulted in many collaborations with the Unusual Incidents Unit of the FBI and with the Boring-based Wilson's Wildlife Solutions.

Site-65 is located in the prairie fields north of Saskatoon, a scenic location chosen for its isolation and vast flat area. The Site operates as a cement factory, and forms the SCP Foundation Saskatchewan Operational Region along with Site-177 and Site-AE7.…

noms.zh-CN: 生物性收容站点-66Biological Containment Site-66

entites.resume: Originally built as Provisional Site-66 around SCP-1479, Bio-Site-66 has been built in and around a former coal-fired power plant, expanding the facility to contain and research a wide variety of biological and organic anomalies. * Of Beauty and Beasts * Tasers & Thermite

Site-666 is a large-scale research, containment, and staging site, publicly known as the Luxor Hotel and Casino. The Site lies within the anomalous hotspot of Undervegas, anchoring the Las Vegas Strip to baseline reality. The Site primarily deals with anomalies in the Las Vegas/Paradise region, but occasionally serves outlying areas.…
Established in the 1930s by O5-7, the purpose of Site-69 is a closely-guarded secret.

Protected Site-7 is a centralized headquarters and command center for the Records, Archival, and Information Security Administration (RAISA), which handles almost every aspect of the Foundation's technical and infosec concerns. The highly-classified facility is made up of nine offshore oil rigs that have been extensively retrofitted to support almost 400 RAISA personnel and their workstations.…

Site-73 is a facility within a converted office building, designed for the containment and study of inert, Safe-class, or otherwise benign anomalous objects, including the analysis and storage of deceased specimens. The Site also manages satellite facilities such as Storage Location 73-E. * Dr. Robinson's Statement

noms.zh-CN: 圣物研究与收容站点-76Reliquary Research and Containment Site-76

entites.resume: Site-76 is a major containment site located in the United States of America, housing a large number of anomalous objects presumed to be man-made. The Site is one of the oldest American facilities still in operation, located within former US government buildings.…

One of the Foundation's largest storage facilities, Site-77 was initially built in 1924 in southern Italy and served as an Italian containment facility until the second World War, when it was damaged by Allied bombing and subsequently destroyed by a containment breach. Site-77 was taken over by the Foundation and rebuilt in 1944.

Site-78 is a Research and Development facility located in the rural town of Chugwater, where the anomalous is just a part of everyday life. The Site's R&D efforts are focused on cataloging the town's oddities as well as the containment, monitoring, and investigation into the Set of Nine; a series of anomalous books believed to be capable of creating a CK-Class Reality Restructuring Scenario.

Site-79 is a facility constructed outside the Yumegēmu Nexus, a location with anomalous properties themed around video games, logic puzzles, and dream logic. In addition to containing Nexus-58, the Site specialises in studying anomalies related to games, dreams, and the Oneiroi Collective.

Site-80 was founded in 1909 by a Swedish anomalous containment organisation that was later incorporated into Foundation, the Secret Committee for Paranormal Findings. Site-80 primarily serves as an archive for religious and mythological texts and anomalous items, with employees advising on the containment of related anomalies throughout Sweden.…

noms.zh-CN: 研究与收容站点-81Research and Containment Site-81

entites.resume: Located beneath Lake Monroe, Site-81 is the primary hub for anomalous activity in the United States Midwest. Initially founded as an expeditionary site to monitor SCP-2812, Site-81 has since grown to become one of the largest sites in the region. Located within is the Foundation's Classifications Committee, as well as a massive Mobile Task Force deployment post.

Originally established as Provisional Site-83 for the containment of SCP-5967, Site-83 primarily houses Euclid and Safe class anomalies, and so has a more relaxed staff than other Foundation Sites. There are only a few Keter and Esoteric class anomalies contained within, under the jurisdiction of higher-clearance staff.…

Bio Site-84 is a remote facility in the Australian Outback near the town of Alice Springs, used for the containment of anomalous animals, both native to Australia and imported in from other facilities. Despite being located in a desert, the facility is capable of simulating and sustaining more temperate habitats within underground containment chambers.

Site-87 is a research site, established in September 1976 to oversee the containment of a minor anomaly in the town of Sloth's Pit (pop. 17,291 as of 2020). In that same month, researchers discovered that Sloth's Pit was a highly active Nexus, an inhabited zone with a high concentration of anomalous phenomena.…

noms.zh-CN: 人形生物收容站点-88Humanoid Containment Site-88

entites.resume: Site-88 houses many humanoid SCP objects, along with several high-value anomalous items, as well as serving as a base for Foundation operations throughout the Gulf Coast Region of the Southern United States. While research is not a primary focus of the Site, it has the capacity for it and has overseen many projects related to its occupants.

noms.zh-CN: 地质学研究站点-898Geological Research Site-898

entites.resume: Founded on blood and coal dust, Site-898 rests in the depths of the Northern Appalachian Mountains. Built in 1966 after the discovery of SCP-8987, the Site's grounds are an unconventional one. Heavily wooded, bordering both swamp and mountain, the staff are housed in a mining town's old cabins, and the main facility extends down into the mine herself.

noms.zh-CN: 异种生物性研究与收容站点-91Xenobiological Research and Containment Site-91

entites.resume: Established as Provisional Site-91 in 1986, shortly after the discovery of SCP-4612 in the substructure below a manor known as Eckhart House. The Site was fully commissioned by Overwatch command the following year and was expanded into a full containment facility, research lab and library focused on the containment and analysis of xenobiological specimens, with a secondary focus on the development of thaumaturgical c…

noms.zh-CN: 生物性研究与收容站点-95Biological Research and Containment Site-95

entites.resume: Location: Hobart, Tasmania, Australia

noms.zh-CN: 维度性研究站点-98Dimensional Research Site-98

entites.resume: Site-98 develops and innovates the bleeding-edge technologies that enable the Foundation to contain, analyze, and research various anomalous threats endangering the world, all behind the front of NASA research. Site-98 is often considered to be the Foundation's most technologically-advanced research facility.

noms.zh-CN: 生物性研究区域-12Biological Research Area-12

entites.resume: Serving as the Foundation's premier parabiological research facility, Area-12 manages many satellite installations across one of the largest areas of land currently under Foundation control.

noms.zh-CN: 武装生物性收容区域-14Armed Biological Containment Area-14

entites.resume: Area-14 is a dedicated facility for the containment of large-scale, dangerous, and/or hostile anomalous entities, and is staffed with a regiment-strength security detachment, equipped with heavy weapons, armored vehicles, and air support. The facility, officially off-limits to the public and designated as a military firing range, serves as the primary station of MTF Nu-7 (“Hammer Down”).

noms.zh-CN: 武装圣物与收容区域-02Armed Reliquary and Containment Area-02

entites.resume: Area-02 is a remote facility whose primary purpose is to contain highly dangerous, hostile, or otherwise hazardous anomalies, including multiple Keter-class objects. In addition to a battalion-strength security detachment, Area-02 is also equipped with multiple nuclear fail-safes as a final option in the case of a catastrophic breach or loss of containment.…

Located beneath a decommissioned chemical plant on the banks of the Danube River, Area-21 is the headquarters of the Foundation's think tank for the neutralization of esoteric effluence: the Acroamatic Abatement Group.

Area-27 is an underground facility beneath the Saint Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica. Area-27 serves as both the headquarters for the Department of Tactical Theology and as emergency quartering in the case of a large-scale K-Class Scenario. The site is also used to develop theological weaponry and to contain religiously-orientated anomalies.

Area-314 is a research, containment, and administrative facility, located a few hours out from Iqaluit, Nunavut. Originally an overbuilt warehouse in the frozen desert of northern Canada, Area-314 serves as the headquarters of the Accounting Department and is the hub for most research, development, and application of esoteric financial assets.

Consisting of several floors beneath the lunar surface, and built around the ninth destination point of SCP-120, Lunar Area-32 is a facility used to contain immobile anomalies present on the lunar surface, or for anomalies that are significantly less hazardous to contain outside of Earth’s atmosphere.

Area-34 is a dedicated facility for the Department of Anomalous Weapons Development. As such, the majority of the facility is dedicated to the study, research, and development of anomalous weaponry. It also serves as the primary response and containment facility for Central America. Area-34 was constructed in the 1980s at the behest of the then-director of AWD.

Area-09 is a facility located just outside the small reservation community of Duckwater. This remote facility serves as the headquarters for the Emergent Threat Tactical Response Authority (ETTRA), the Foundation department responsible for finding innovative solutions to the threats posed by hostile Groups of Interest.…
